## [2.1.0-dev.1](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0-dev.1) (2026-09-07)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Open Watchlist as a self-contained overlay screen, not the deep link ([74fc4d2](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/74fc4d2b79c3d4635f16fa2ef7f10be22503ce40))
* Watchlist icon uses a StateListDrawable so it tints per state ([19c9842](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/19c98425c71c06ba8f182b82a31c8b93c781b49e))
* Watchlist nav goes through the Profile tab, no back-stack wedge ([be196f9](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/be196f9326ace0687c0919dc3d58560eb72393ed))
* Watchlist overlay crash — use FragmentLifecycleCallbacks not OnBackStackChangedListener ([0852753](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/08527532a5947a7c84245abbd05f967e4c6c1eba))
* Watchlist tab switches on one tap — navigate with the app's tab NavOptions ([198f5b4](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/198f5b455155d6b17b962277aba6b03ee1b8060f))

### ✨ New Features

* Add "Runtime as 1h 47m" film-page toggle ([8425584](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/8425584bb5c56888d01e94fc13a46d74de3eeb80))
* Add Hide ads patch (AdMob banner removal) ([40e94f1](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/40e94f1b29ab25cd23246b9ae5807fd39df1459f))
* Add Plex as an "Open in player" target ([e8edd1b](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/e8edd1b611894d0d63bf1d27e2062f2067a948c2))
* Customisable bottom nav — pick items, add Watchlist, choose launch tab ([70f8bc0](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/70f8bc0935e33258e322ce8f9571563f254c0991))
* Dynamic watchlist icon tint + real glyphs in Mod settings dialogs ([2bea797](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/2bea7972f3cdd940fba77a1e556cb34a9edfad2b)), closes [#AABBCC](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/issues/AABBCC)
* Home tab strip — hide, reorder and default the home sections ([af13174](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/af1317411aefe5178bc9b3ab8998fbe589433243))
* Rework the what's-new dialog for this release ([3611903](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/36119033d682c6951f0a43f4d276a7047715b561))
* Watchlist as a real bottom-nav tab, not an overlay ([4995358](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/4995358505cb99e3a56f31baa18c2dad17602a3a))
* Watchlist tab highlights itself; auto-pops on switching away ([ce1922e](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/ce1922efda25349e291599a6c02f17315cd30600))
* What's-new dialog gets a GitHub link + permanent footer; Mods screen gets an About row ([22aa854](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/22aa854c9e00794c3bf20dfe2d007671f9b57a8c))
